name: Limbo Line
source:
Welcome to SSL, one of Limbo's many offices! Taking control of our protagonist, Nine, you must serve your sentence by taking on support calls from denizens of the multiverse.

[From [url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/limbo-line]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到SSL，这里是灵薄狱众多办事处之一！你将扮演主人公Nine，通过接听多元宇宙居民打来的求助电话，完成自己的刑期。

[摘自[url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/limbo-line]Itch.io[/url]]
